muyesser-irab:1-1.t:
﴿والنازعات﴾: the wāw is a particle of oath and genitive, and «النازعات» is a noun in the genitive by the wāw of oath, the sign of its genitive being the kasra; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, i.e. "I swear"; the oath clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position.
﴿غرقا﴾: standing in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), being synonymous with its governor ﴿النازعات﴾, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa; the answer to the oath is omitted, i.e. "you will surely be resurrected" (لنبعثن).

muyesser-irab:2-2.t:
﴿والناشطات﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «الناشطات» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to ﴿النازعات﴾, genitive (majrūr), the sign of its genitive being the kasra.
﴿نشطا﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa.

muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿والسابحات﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «السابحات» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to ﴿النازعات﴾, genitive (majrūr), the sign of its genitive being the kasra.
﴿سبحا﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa.

muyesser-irab:4-4.t:
﴿فالسابقات﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction for sequence, and «السابقات» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to ﴿النازعات﴾, genitive (majrūr), the sign of its genitive being the kasra.
﴿سبقا﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa.

muyesser-irab:5-5.t:
﴿فالمدبرات﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction for sequence and immediate succession, and «السابقات» [Translator's note: so in the source, carried over from the previous ayah; the word parsed here is «المدبرات»] is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to ﴿النازعات﴾, genitive (majrūr), the sign of its genitive being the kasra.
﴿أمرا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa.

muyesser-irab:6-6.t:
﴿يوم﴾: an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted answer to the oath.
﴿ترجف﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma.
﴿الراجفة﴾: the fāʿil (agent) of «ترجف», nominative, the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma; the clause is in the position of a genitive, the adverb being put in construct with it.

muyesser-irab:7-7.t:
﴿تتبعها﴾: «تتبع» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma, and ﴿ها﴾ is an indeclinable (mabnī) pronoun in the position of an accusative, mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿الرادفة﴾: the fāʿil (agent) of «تتبع», nominative, the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma; the clause ﴿تتبعها الرادفة﴾ is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿الراجفة﴾.

muyesser-irab:8-8.t:
﴿قلوب﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma.
﴿يومئذ﴾: ﴿يوم﴾ is an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿واجفة﴾; and ﴿إذٍ﴾ is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on a sukūn implied (muqaddar) because its place is occupied by the tanwīn of compensation, in the position of a genitive (majrūr), muḍāf ilayhi; the tanwīn compensates for an omitted clause, the implied form being: "hearts trembling on the day when the quaking quakes, followed by the subsequent one".
﴿واجفة﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿قلوب﴾, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma.

muyesser-irab:9-9.t:
﴿أبصارها﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma; ﴿ها﴾ is an indeclinable (mabnī) pronoun in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿خاشعة﴾: khabar (predicate), nominative, the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma; the clause ﴿خاشعة أبصارهم﴾ [Translator's note: so in the source, for «أبصارها خاشعة»] is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of the first mubtadaʾ ﴿قلوب﴾.

muyesser-irab:10-10.t:
﴿يقولون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn; the wāw of the plural is a pronoun indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of a nominative, fāʿil (agent); the clause «يقولون» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "hum" (they), and the clause ﴿هم يقولون﴾ is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿أئنا﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative; «إن» is an abrogating, accusative-governing particle indeclinable on fatḥa, with no grammatical position; and ﴿نا﴾ is an indeclinable pronoun in the position of an accusative, the noun of «إن».
﴿لمردودون﴾: the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and «مردودون» is the khabar of «إن», nominative, the sign of its nominative being the wāw; the clause ﴿أئنا لمردودون﴾ is in the position of an accusative, the content of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿في﴾: a preposition.
﴿الحافرة﴾: a noun in the genitive, the sign of its genitive being the kasra; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿مردودون﴾.

muyesser-irab:11-11.t:
﴿أئذا﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval (al-istifhām al-inkārī), and «إذا» is an adverb (ẓarf) for future time, containing the meaning of condition, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of an accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) what ﴿مردودون﴾ indicates, i.e. "we will be returned" (نرد).
﴿كنا﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb indeclinable on sukūn, and ﴿نا﴾ is a pronoun indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of a nominative, the khabar of the noun of kāna [Translator's note: so in the source («خبر اسم كان»); ﴿نا﴾ is in fact the noun of kāna].
﴿عظاما﴾: the khabar of kāna, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa.
﴿نخرة﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿عظاما﴾, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa; the clause ﴿كنا﴾ is in the position of a genitive, the adverb being put in construct with it; and the apodosis of ﴿أئذا﴾ is omitted, indicated by ﴿مردودون﴾, i.e. "we will be returned".

muyesser-irab:12-12.t:
﴿قالوا﴾: a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma; the wāw of the plural is a pronoun indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of a nominative, fāʿil (agent).
﴿تلك﴾: the tāʾ is a demonstrative indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of a nominative, mubtadaʾ (subject); the lām is for distance, and the kāf is an indeclinable pronoun in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿إذًا﴾: a particle indeclinable on fatḥa, for answer and requital.
﴿كرة﴾: the khabar (predicate) of «تلك», nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma.
﴿خاسرة﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿كرة﴾, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma; the clause ﴿قالوا﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and the clause ﴿تلك إذًا كرة خاسرة﴾ is in the position of an accusative, the content of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).

muyesser-irab:13-13.t:
﴿فإنما﴾: the fāʾ is a particle of resumption; «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh) indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, with no grammatical position; and «ما» restrains ﴿إن﴾ from its government (kāffa).
﴿هي﴾: a detached pronoun indeclinable on fatḥa, in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿زجرة﴾: the khabar (predicate) of «هي», nominative, the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma.
﴿واحدة﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿زجرة﴾, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:14-14.t:
﴿فإذا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «إذا» is of surprise (fujāʾiyya).
﴿هم﴾: a pronoun indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa [Translator's note: so in the source; «هم» ends in a sukūn], in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), mubtadaʾ (subject); the mīm is the sign of the plural.
﴿بالساهرة﴾: the khabar (predicate) of ﴿هم﴾, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma [Translator's note: so in the source; ﴿بالساهرة﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar]; the clause is conjoined to the clause ﴿إنما هي زجرة واحدة﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:15-15.t:
﴿هل﴾: an interrogative particle indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, with no grammatical position.
﴿أتاك﴾: «أتى» is a past verb indeclinable on fatḥa, and the kāf is an indeclinable pronoun in the position of an accusative, mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿حديث﴾: the fāʿil (agent) of «أتى», nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma; it is muḍāf.
﴿موسى﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) by a kasra implied (muqaddar) on the alif; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:16-16.t:
﴿إذ﴾: an adverb (ẓarf) for past time, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of an accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿حديث﴾.
﴿ناداه﴾: «نادى» is a past verb indeclinable on fatḥa, and the hāʾ is an indeclinable pronoun in the position of an accusative, mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿ربه﴾: «رب» is the fāʿil (agent) of «نادى», nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma; it is muḍāf, and the hāʾ is an indeclinable pronoun in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿بالواد﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition indeclinable on kasra, and ﴿الواد﴾ is a noun in the genitive, the sign of the genitive being a kasra implied (muqaddar) on the elided yāʾ; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿ناداه﴾.
﴿المقدس﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿الوادي﴾, genitive, the sign of its genitive being the kasra.
﴿طوى﴾: a badal (substitute) from «الوادي», genitive by a kasra implied on the alif; the clause ﴿ناداه﴾ is in the position of a genitive, the adverb being put in construct with it.

muyesser-irab:17-17.t:
﴿اذهب﴾: an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn; the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "anta" (you).
﴿إلى﴾: a preposition indeclinable on sukūn.
﴿فرعون﴾: a noun in the genitive, the sign of its genitive being the fatḥa, because it is a diptote; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿اذهب﴾.
﴿إنه﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), indeclinable on fatḥa, with no grammatical position, and the hāʾ is an indeclinable pronoun in the position of an accusative, the noun of ﴿إن﴾.
﴿طغى﴾: a past verb indeclinable on fatḥa; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "huwa" (he), referring back to Pharaoh; the clause ﴿طغى﴾ is in the position of a nominative, the khabar (predicate) of «إن», and the clause ﴿اذهب﴾ is in the position of an accusative, the content of an omitted saying.

muyesser-irab:18-18.t:
﴿فقل﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, and «قل» is an imperative verb indeclinable on sukūn; the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "anta" (you); the clause ﴿قل﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿اذهب﴾.
﴿هل﴾: an interrogative particle indeclinable on sukūn, with no grammatical position.
﴿لك﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "a desire existing for you"; the interrogative clause is in the position of an accusative, the content of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿إلى﴾: a preposition.
﴿أن﴾: a maṣdar-forming, accusative-governing particle, indeclinable on sukūn.
﴿تزكى﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being a fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "anta" (you); the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن تزكى﴾ is in the genitive by ﴿إلى﴾, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted «رغبة» (desire).

muyesser-irab:19-19.t:
﴿وأهديك﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «أهديك» is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa, conjoined to ﴿تزكى﴾; the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being ﴿أنا﴾ (I); and the kāf is an indeclinable (mabnī) pronoun in the position of an accusative, mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿إلى﴾: a preposition indeclinable on sukūn.
﴿ربك﴾: «رب» is a noun in the genitive, the sign of its genitive being the kasra; it is muḍāf, and the kāf is an indeclinable pronoun in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أهديك﴾.
﴿فتخشى﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; [«تخشى» is] an imperfect verb, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the implied (muqaddar) fatḥa, conjoined to ﴿تزكى﴾; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "anta" (you).

muyesser-irab:20-20.t:
﴿فأراه﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «أراه» is a past verb; its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa" (he); and the hāʾ is a pronoun in the position of an accusative, the first object of ﴿أرى﴾.
﴿الآية﴾: the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿أرى﴾.
﴿الكبرى﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿الآية﴾, accusative (manṣūb).

muyesser-irab:21-21.t:
﴿فكذب﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «كذب» is a past verb; its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being ﴿هو﴾ (he).
﴿وعصى﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «كذب» [Translator's note: so in the source, carried over from the line above; the verb parsed here is «عصى»] is a past verb; its fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "huwa" (he); the two clauses ﴿كذب﴾ and ﴿عصى﴾ are conjoined to ﴿أُراه﴾.

muyesser-irab:22-22.t:
﴿ثم﴾: a conjunction.
﴿أدبر﴾: a past verb; its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa" (he); the clause ﴿أدبر﴾ is conjoined to ﴿عصى﴾.
﴿يسعى﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "huwa" (he); the clause ﴿يسعى﴾ is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in ﴿أدبر﴾.

muyesser-irab:23-23.t:
﴿فحشر﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «حشر» is a past verb; its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa" (he).
﴿فنادى﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «نادى» is a past verb; its fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "huwa" (he); the clause ﴿فحشر﴾ is conjoined to ﴿أدبر﴾, and the clause ﴿فنادى﴾ is conjoined to ﴿فحشر﴾.

muyesser-irab:24-24.t:
﴿فقال﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «قال» is a past verb; its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa" (he); the clause ﴿فقال﴾ is conjoined to ﴿فنادى﴾.
﴿أنا﴾: a pronoun in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿ربكم﴾: «رب» is the khabar (predicate), and the pronoun is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿الأعلى﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿رب﴾, nominative; the clause ﴿أنا ربكم﴾ is in the position of an accusative, the content of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).

muyesser-irab:25-25.t:
﴿فأخذه﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «أخذ» is a past verb; the hāʾ is an indeclinable (mabnī) pronoun in the position of an accusative, a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿أخذه﴾ is conjoined to ﴿قال﴾.
﴿الله﴾: the Name of Majesty, fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ).
﴿نكال﴾: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), accusative (manṣūb).
﴿الآخرة﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr).
﴿والأولى﴾: conjoined to «الآخرة», genitive by an implied (muqaddar) kasra.

muyesser-irab:26-26.t:
﴿إن﴾: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh).
﴿في﴾: a preposition.
﴿ذلك﴾: a demonstrative in the position of a genitive; the preposition and its genitive noun are in the position of a nominative, the fronted khabar (predicate) of «إن».
﴿لعبرة﴾: the lām is the emphasising lām of ibtidāʾ, and «عبرة» is the postponed noun of «إن».
﴿لمن﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿عبرة﴾.
﴿يخشى﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa" (he); the clause ﴿يخشى﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:27-27.t:
﴿أأنتم﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of reproach (al-istifhām al-tawbīkhī), and «أنتم» is mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿أشد﴾: khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ).
﴿خلقا﴾: tamyīz (specification), accusative (manṣūb).
﴿أم﴾: a conjunction.
﴿السماء﴾: a noun conjoined to ﴿أنتم﴾, nominative.
﴿بناها﴾: «بنى» is a past verb; its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa" (He); ﴿ها﴾ is an indeclinable (mabnī) pronoun in the position of an accusative, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿بناها﴾ is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:28-28.t:
﴿رفع﴾: a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa; its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa" (He).
﴿سمكها﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), and the pronoun is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿فسواها﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «سواها» is a past verb indeclinable on fatḥa; its fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "huwa" (He); and the pronoun is in the position of an accusative, mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿رفع﴾ is a badal (substitute) from the clause ﴿بناها﴾, and the clause ﴿سواها﴾ is conjoined to ﴿رفع﴾.

muyesser-irab:29-29.t:
﴿وأغطش﴾: a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa; its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa" (He).
﴿ليلها﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), and the pronoun is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿وأخرج﴾: a past verb indeclinable on fatḥa; its fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "huwa" (He).
﴿ضحاها﴾: mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and the pronoun is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi; the two clauses ﴿أغطش﴾ and ﴿أخرج﴾ are conjoined to ﴿رفع﴾.

muyesser-irab:30-30.t:
﴿والأرض﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «الأرض» is accusative (manṣūb) by preoccupation (ʿalā al-ishtighāl), by an omitted verb indicated by what follows it.
﴿بعد﴾: an adverb (ẓarf), attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿دحاها﴾.
﴿ذلك﴾: a demonstrative in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿دحاها﴾: a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa; its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa" (He); and the pronoun is in the position of an accusative, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause ﴿دحاها﴾ is explicative (tafsīriyya), with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:31-31.t:
﴿أخرج﴾: a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa; its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa" (He).
﴿منها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أخرج﴾.
﴿ماءها﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), and the pronoun is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿ومرعاها﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «مرعى» is a noun conjoined to ﴿ماءها﴾, and the pronoun is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi. The clause ﴿أخرج...﴾ explains His saying ﴿دحاها﴾, so it has no grammatical position; or it is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الأرض», with «قد» implied.

muyesser-irab:32-32.t:
﴿والجبال﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «الجبال» is accusative (manṣūb) by preoccupation (ʿalā al-ishtighāl), by an omitted verb indicated by what follows it.
﴿أرساها﴾: a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa; its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa" (He); and the pronoun is in the position of an accusative, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause ﴿أرساها﴾ is explicative (tafsīriyya), with no grammatical position. The clause ﴿الجبال أرساها﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿الأرض بعد ذلك دحاها﴾.

muyesser-irab:33-33.t:
﴿متاعا﴾: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), accusative (manṣūb); or standing in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, because it is a noun of the maṣdar (ism maṣdar), the implied form being: "He gives you provision".
﴿لكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿متاعا﴾.
﴿ولأنعامكم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and the lām is a preposition; «أنعامكم» is a noun in the genitive, and the pronoun is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿لأنعامكم﴾ is conjoined to ﴿لكم﴾.

muyesser-irab:34-34.t:
﴿فإذا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «إذا» is an adverb (ẓarf) for future time, containing the meaning of condition.
﴿جاءت﴾: a past verb, the tāʾ being for the feminine; the clause ﴿جاءت﴾ is in the position of a genitive, the adverb being put in construct with it.
﴿الطامة﴾: the fāʿil (agent) of «جاءت», nominative (marfūʿ).
﴿الكبرى﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿الطامة﴾, nominative.

muyesser-irab:35-35.t:
﴿يوم﴾: «يوم» is a badal (substitute) from ﴿إذا﴾, accusative (manṣūb).
﴿يتذكر﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); the clause «يتذكر» is in the position of a genitive by being put in construct.
﴿الإنسان﴾: the fāʿil (agent) of «يتذكر», nominative.
﴿ما﴾: maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya).
﴿سعى﴾: a past verb; the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿ما سعى﴾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:36-36.t:
﴿وبرزت﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; [«برزت» is] a past verb, passive (built for that whose agent is not named); ﴿برزت﴾ is conjoined to ﴿جاءت﴾.
﴿الجحيم﴾: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative (marfūʿ).
﴿لمن﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿برزت﴾.
﴿يرى﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative.

muyesser-irab:37-37.t:
﴿فأما﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; «أما» is a particle of condition and detailing.
﴿من﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿طغى﴾: a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa; its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa" (he); the clause ﴿طغى﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:38-38.t:
﴿وآثر﴾: a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa; its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa" (he); ﴿آثر﴾ is conjoined to ﴿طغى﴾.
﴿الحياة﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb).
﴿الدنيا﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿الحياة﴾, accusative.

muyesser-irab:39-39.t:
﴿فإن﴾: the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis of ﴿أما﴾, and «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh).
﴿الجحيم﴾: the noun of «إن», accusative (manṣūb).
﴿هي﴾: a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl).
﴿المأوى﴾: the khabar (predicate) of «إن», nominative (marfūʿ); the clause is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of ﴿من﴾.

muyesser-irab:40-40.t:
﴿وأما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «أما» is a particle of condition and detailing.
﴿من﴾: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿خاف﴾: a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa; its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa" (he); the clause ﴿من خاف﴾ is conjoined to ﴿من طغى﴾, and the clause ﴿خاف﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿مقام﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb).
﴿ربه﴾: «رب» is muḍāf ilayhi, and the pronoun is also muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿ونهى﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; [«نهى» is] a past verb indeclinable on fatḥa; its fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "huwa" (he); the clause ﴿ونهى﴾ is conjoined to ﴿خاف﴾.
﴿النفس﴾: mafʿūl bihi, accusative.
﴿عن﴾: a preposition indeclinable on sukūn.
﴿الهوى﴾: a noun in the genitive, the sign of its genitive being the kasra [Translator's note: so in the source; on «الهوى» the kasra is implied on the alif]; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نهى﴾.

muyesser-irab:41-41.t:
﴿فإن﴾: the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis of ﴿أما﴾, and «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh).
﴿الجنة﴾: the noun of «إن», accusative (manṣūb).
﴿هي﴾: a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl).
﴿المأوى﴾: the khabar (predicate) of «إن», nominative (marfūʿ); the clause is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of ﴿من﴾.

muyesser-irab:42-42.t:
﴿يسألونك﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil (agent), and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿عن﴾: a preposition indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn.
﴿الساعة﴾: a noun in the genitive (majrūr).
﴿أيان﴾: an interrogative noun in the position of an accusative as an adverb of time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate).
﴿مرساها﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), and the pronoun ﴿ها﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi. The clause ﴿أيان مرساها﴾ is explicative (tafsīriyya), with no grammatical position; or it is in the position of an accusative by an omitted saying indicated by the verb ﴿يسألونك﴾, the implied form being: ﴿يقولون أيان مرساها﴾ ("they say: when is its arrival?").

muyesser-irab:43-43.t:
﴿فيم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate).
﴿أنت﴾: a pronoun in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿من﴾: a preposition indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn.
﴿ذكراها﴾: a noun in the genitive, and the pronoun is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to that to which the khabar is attached; the clause has no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:44-44.t:
﴿إلى﴾: an indeclinable (mabnī) preposition.
﴿ربك﴾: «رب» is a noun in the genitive, and the pronoun is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi; the preposition and its genitive noun are in the position of a nominative, khabar (predicate).
﴿منتهاها﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), and the pronoun is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:45-45.t:
﴿إنما﴾: [«إنّ»] restrained by the restraining «ما» (kāffa wa-makfūfa).
﴿أنت﴾: a pronoun in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿منذر﴾: khabar (predicate), nominative.
﴿من﴾: a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿يخشاها﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative; the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, and ﴿ها﴾ is a pronoun in the position of an accusative, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿يخشاها﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿من﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:46-46.t:
﴿كأنهم﴾: «كأن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and ﴿هم﴾ is its noun.
﴿يوم﴾: «يوم» is an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān), accusative (manṣūb).
﴿يرونها﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil (agent), and ﴿ها﴾ is a pronoun in the position of an accusative, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is in the position of a genitive.
﴿لم﴾: a particle of negation, conversion [of the imperfect to past meaning], and jussive.
﴿يلبثوا﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative [Translator's note: so in the source; after «لم» the verb is jussive (majzūm), the sign being the elision of the nūn], and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil; the clause ﴿لم يلبثوا﴾ is in the position of a nominative, the khabar (predicate) of «كأن».
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr).
﴿عشية﴾: an adverb of time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يلبثوا﴾.
﴿أو﴾: a conjunction.
﴿ضحاها﴾: conjoined to «عشية», accusative by an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa, and the pronoun is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.
